access_sequence: commit source/protocol/roles before reference or fit labels
freeze selected reference before Qref labels
freeze predictors/comparators before independent complete audit
freeze final checkpoints/runtime heads before primary/retention outcomes

confirmation.fallback_consumes_final_sources: Even frozen-only confirmation consumes these entire primary/retention roles for every future study, including learning
confirmation.fixed_policy_scope: seed-specific best original-model open-loop plan fromruntime_select reused byfixedarmsA/B/C; ordinary andfield-specific fixedbest retainedasdiagnostics
confirmation.frozen_only_fallback: A,D,H,J,K only if frozenruntimeauditpasses butlearning/combinedqualificationfails; count unrun primarycontrasts as not established; reserve six-comparison correction
confirmation.gain_rule: correctedCI lower>0 andeachfixedseedmean>0 underbothobservers, pluscandidate cleanNI; no equality/noninferiority claims fromnonsignificance
confirmation.population_scope: conditional on3fixedhistorical models; sourcepairs are constructed MNIST task units, not newwriters/LLMs or production users
confirmation.quantile: numpy.quantile method=linear, equal-tail two-sided interval alpha/family_comparisons
confirmation.resampling: one shared paired sourcepaircluster sample across all arms,seeds,conditions; seeds fixed; separate registered primary andretention draw streams

observer_independence: Both fixed observers enter development gates; audit observer is a distinct measurement model, not development-blind. Conjunction tests control claims; individual corrected intervals do not assert simultaneous coverage of both observers together.
prior_study_boundary: V1/V2 sources, frozen thresholds and outcomes remain immutable; V3 is a new prospectively registered intervention and task

runtime.candidate_selection: largest exact selected policy mean reward onruntime_select; listed transform/ridge tie order
runtime.feedback: after actual selected output at depths1and2 is persisted/read back, verifier emits prescheduled side caption-correct ±1 and1−2pixelMSE; no class/source pixels/future feedback exposed
runtime.feedback_side: SHA256(case_id:depth) first byte modulo2; case_id excludes arm/profile/action
runtime.fixed_policy: best ofall85 open-loop terminal plans selected onruntime_select, lowest BFS index tie
runtime.frozen_scope_independent: frozen profile runtime qualification may proceed even if training qualification fails; do not relabel this as combined-layer success
runtime.head_targets: backward stage fitting under each candidate own later frozen heads; no oracle-tail targets
runtime.latency_acceptance: No wallclock threshold; fixed deterministic work ceilings, actual CPU/wall timings reported descriptively with host metadata
runtime.native_flag_scope: requires_calibration remains the original kernel receipt flag true; local readout fitting does not clear it. This bounded research requires DENY_ALL and no owner integration, and makes no production calibration claim.
runtime.task: three-decision constructed PNG/UTF-8 revision with delayed simulated verifier feedback
runtime.training_deployment_transfer: TrainingQref/guard/audit use the historical single-action fixedpolicy; sequential85-plan deployment is a different prespecified task. No identical training/deployment objective claim.

runtime_audit_gate.claim_family: Four corrected comparisons support the independently registered frozen profile scope or the conjunction over all3 profiles; no cherry-picked per-profile confirmatory claims
runtime_audit_gate.passing_profile_rule: frozen scope qualifies independently; combined confirmation requires learning audit plus runtime audits for all3profiles
runtime_audit_gate.quantile: numpy.quantile method=linear; equal-tail two-sided interval alpha/family_comparisons

training.fit_ridge_selection: whole-trajectory leave-one-out prediction MSE, fit-only normalization, listed-alpha tie break
training.fixed_actions_source: V2 frozen PILOT_SUMMARY.json original-model winners; no V3 outcome selection
training.guard_failure: restore full parameter and SGD state; advance schedule clock; charge all work
training.value_target: Q_ref terminal hard utility after candidate48-step block followed by frozen reference policy to288; not optimal Q or deployed-policy value
training.zero_action: compute and charge gradients; do not step or modify parameters/momentum

training_audit_gate.acceptance: all gains and clean NI comparisons pass under both observers; one independent audit only
training_audit_gate.quantile: numpy.quantile method=linear; equal-tail two-sided interval alpha/family_comparisons
training_audit_gate.resampling: 4000 hierarchical draws: resample4 paired complete rollout IDs independently within each fixedseed with SAME draws for every method; use SAME sourcepair cluster sample across all methods,seeds,conditions; equal seed andcondition weights

training_development_gate.adaptive_selection: one method among generic,richer,h7 by pooled reward utility after each-seed clean eligibility under both observers; listed method tie break
training_development_gate.no_eligible_candidate: Qualification failure; no implicit alternative comparator or fallback
training_development_gate.no_family_selection: H12 is fixed candidate irrespective of other feature-family outcomes
training_development_gate.ordinary_selection: per-seed highest mean reward utility among4 complete constants eligible under both clean observers; lowest action index tie break
